10/27/26

# THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE MALDEN HOUSING AUTHORITY

The regular meeting of the Malden Housing Authority (MHA) was held on October 27, 2026, at 8:30 AM at the office of the Authority, 630 Salem Street, Malden, MA 02148. All votes are by roll call with remote Commissioners.

COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING: Frank M. Molis, William P. Hurley and Karin H. Nystrom

COMMISSIONERS ATTENDING REMOTELY: Joan M. Chiasson and Emmanuel Marsh

MHA STAFF ATTENDING: Stephen G. Finn, Thomas P. Callaghan and Barbara A. Hooley

## 1. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 10-13-26

The Board reviewed the minutes of the 10-13-26 meeting.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Karin H. Nystrom, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve the 10-13-26 meeting minutes.

- Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

## 2. APPROVAL OF THE BILLS AND SIGNING OF CHECKS None

## 3. FINANCIAL MATTERS

### A. MHA FINANCIAL STATEMENTS-AUGUST 2026-Review Only

### B. ODYSSEY ADVISORS INC.--Invoice

The Board analyzed an invoice dated 10/16/26 in the amount of $4,500.00 from Odyssey Advisors Inc. for completion of MHA's FY2026-2027 Pension GASB 74/75 Actuarial Valuation with cost as allocated by the Finance Director.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $4,500.00 from Odyssey Advisors Inc. as detailed above with cost as allocated by the Finance Director.

- Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

### C. YMCA--Invoice

The Board examined an invoice from the YMCA as detailed below:

| Program | Date | Amount | Amp Charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| MHA Resident Memberships-September 2026 | 10-5-26 | $4,166.67 | COCC |

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by William P. Hurley, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve payment in the amount of $4,166.67 to the YMCA for MHA Resident Memberships for the month of September, 2026 with cost paid by the COCC.

- Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None
- Abstain: Frank M. Molis

### D. MHA PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES--MHA Staff

The Board considered Performance Incentives for MHA Staff as detailed below:

**Finance Director:** A FY2027 (10/1/26 - 9/30/27) financial reporting incentive in the amount of $2,500 per quarter (4 times per year) for delivering MHA's Financial Statements to MHA's Fee Accountant no less than seven (7) calendar days prior to the quarterly reporting period due date.

**AMP 1-Linden-$3 plus million Window and Siding Replacement Project-Phase 1**

| Name | Title | Bonus Amount |
|---|---|---|
| James Fletcher | Acting Site Foreman | $2,500.00 |
| John Eccleston | Carpenter/Bricklayer | $2,000.00 |
| Sherry Hall | Public Housing Manager | $1,500.00 |
| Eric Svenson | Principal Foreman | $1,250.00 |
| Rob Sullivan | Modernization & Procurement Manager | $1,250.00 |
| Tylor West | Mechanic | $1,000.00 |
| Shawn Nice Sr. | Laborer | $1,000.00 |
| Mark Giordano | Laborer | $1,000.00 |

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Emmanuel Marsh, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve awarding Performance Bonuses to MHA staff as detailed above with cost paid by the COCC.

- Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Emmanuel Marsh, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

### E. MARCHETTI COMMERCIAL FUELS INC--(Marchetti)--Heating Oil Contract

The Board evaluated a request for confirmation and approval to lock in home heating oil pricing at $5.119/gallon for up to 4,0000 gallons from Marchetti for the period November 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027 with cost to be paid by AMP 1.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Emmanuel Marsh, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To confirm and approve the contract for home heating oil at $5.119/gallon for up to 4,0000 gallons from Marchetti for the period November 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027 with cost to be paid AMP 1

- Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanual Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

### F. SITE IMPROVEMENTS INC.--Notice to Proceed

The Board assessed a confirmation and approval for the Executive Director to issue a Notice to Proceed to Site Improvements Inc. to commence work on the Springdale Development Paving Project with cost paid by the State through CapHub.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by William P. Hurley, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To confirm and approve issuance of Notice to Proceed to Site Improvements Inc. to commence work on the Springdale Development Paving Project with cost paid by the State through CapHub.

- Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

### G. INSTITUTE FOR ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION, INC.--Invoice

The Board perused an invoice dated 10-21-26 in the amount of $1,750.00 from Institute of Environmental Education, Inc. for lead paint compliance report for MHA's Linden Development with cost paid by AMP 1.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Emmanuel Marsh, and seconded by William P. Hurley, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To authorize payment in the amount of $1,750.00 from Institute of Environmental Education, Inc. for lead paint compliance report for MHA's Linden Development with cost paid by AMP 1.

- Ayes: William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

### H. RESOLUTION 2026-15--EOHLC SUBSTATIAL CONTRACT FOR FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE-(CFA)

The Board reviewed MHA Board Resolution 2026-15: To approve and accept Contract for Financial Assistance (CFA 5010) from EOHLC in the amount of $76,744.00 for replacement of Forestdale (State 667-1 and 667-3) toilets and authorization for Executive Director to sign standard contract form.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Joan M. Chiasson and seconded by William P. Hurley, it was unanimously:

RESOLUTION 2026-15 RESOLVED AND VOTED: To approve and accept Contract for Financial Assistance (CFA 5010) from EOHLC in the amount of $76,744.00 for replacement of State 667-1 and 667-3 toilets and authorization for Executive Director to sign standard contract form.

- Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Emmanuel Marsh, Frank M. Molis and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

### I. MALDEN POLICE--Invoices-(8)

The Board studied four (4) invoices from the Malden Police with payments to be allocated to the AMP's served as follows:

| Invoice # | Date | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 37673 | 10-13-26 | $1,012.17 |
| 37687 | 10-14-26 | $337.39 |
| 37703 | 10-15-26 | $674.78 |
| 37728 | 10-19-26 | $1,012.17 |
| TOTAL | | $3,036.51 |

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve payment of four (4) invoices to the Malden Police Department with a total cost of $3,036.51 for detail coverage at various MHA developments with cost to be allocated to the AMP's served.

- Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

## 4. POLICIES AND CONTRACTS None

## 5. REVIEW OF CHARITABLE REQUESTS

a) The Board considered a donation request from the Tommy DeVincentis Scholarship Fund, (benefitting Malden High School Graduates), Golf Tournament being held on Monday, November 2, 2026.

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by William P. Hurley and seconded by Emmanuel Marsh, it was unanimously:

VOTED: To approve and authorize a donation in the amount of $500.00 to the Tommy DeVincentis Scholarship Fund with cost paid by the COCC.

- Ayes: Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom
- Nays: None

## 6. CORRESPONDENCE, PUBLICATIONS AND COMMUNICATIONS:

a) PHADA ADVOCATE October 28, 2026

## 7. REVIEW OF APPROVED FOR PAYMENT CAPITAL INVOICES, REQUISITIONS FOR PAYMENT AND ALL OTHER APPLICABLE PROJECT DOCEMENTATION (EDIFICATION ONLY)

a) Gordon and Griffin Engagement Letter for Fee Accounting Services for the period October 1, 2026 - September 2027 at the cost of $9,900.00/month with a 2 percent increase (to $10,800.00/month) on February 1, 2027 with cost paid as determined by the Finance Director.

b) NRG Business Marketing LLC (NRG) contract for natural gas supply at a cost of $4.901/MMBTU for a three (3) year term beginning January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2029 with cost paid as allocated by the Finance Director.

c) Invoice dated 10-13-26 in the amount of $3,795.00 from Allen & Majors Associates, Inc. for design completed on the Springdale Development Paving Project with cost paid by the state through CapHub.

d) Invoice Dated 10/20/2026 in the amount of $7,500.00 from MKA Architecture for design completed on Phase 2 of the AMP 1-Linden Window and Siding Project with cost paid by the CFP.

e) FY2026/2027-Insurance Policy Renewal Premiums paid:

| Insurance Company | Type of Insurance | Premium |
|---|---|---|
| Cowbell | Cyber Liability | $13,479.12 |
| Palms Specialty Ins Co | Lead Liability | $5,331.68 |
| H A Risk Retention | Commercial Liability | $76,241.00 |
| H A Property Insurance | Commercial Property | $410,633.63 |

f) Executive Directors FY2027 Energy Report Submissions in HUD's Epic Electronic Reporting System.

g) Task Order Contract with Michael Kim Architecture, LLC in the amount of $27,500.00 for design engineering on the acquisition, permitting and installation of a replacement emergency generator in accordance with code and regulation at 557 Pleasant Street with cost to be paid by AMP 5 and Operating Reserves if necessary.

## 8. REVIEW OF APPROVED TRAINING AND CONFERNCE OFFERINGS

a) NSHEDA Monthly Meeting Tuesday, November 17, 2026-10:30am at Spinelli's Lynnfield, MA.

## 9. OPEN DISCUSSION

a) Review of an approval for MHA Administrative Supervisory staff to expend up to $6,000.00 from the COCC to purchase holiday gift cards for MHA public housing resident and voucher participant families ($6,000.00 last year).

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Joan M. Chiasson, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve and authorize MHA Administrative Supervisory staff to expend up to $6,000.00 from the COCC to purchase holiday gift cards for MHA public housing residents and voucher participant families.

**Ayes:** Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom

**Nays:** None

b) **Proposed MHA Holiday Schedule for 2026.**

\*MHA closing for the remainder of Thanksgiving week at Noon on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, reopening on Monday, November 30, 2026 (Friday following Thanksgiving approved as an additional "holiday" (pursuant to Board vote of 11/8/2022).

\*MHA traditional four (4) shopping hours to be used between 11/30/26 and 12/23/26 to be taken with Supervisors approval.

\* MHA closing on Thursday, December 24th (Christmas Eve) for the remainder of the week with offices reopening on Monday, December 28, 2026. MHA closing on Thursday, December 31, 2026 (New Years Eve) for the remainder of the week with offices reopening on Monday, January 4, 2026.

After due discussion and upon motion duly my Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by William P. Hurley, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To approve MHA's 2026 Holiday Schedule as detailed above.

**Ayes:** Joan M. Chiasson, William P. Hurley, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom

**Nays:** None

c) EPC Solutions, LLC HUD EPC Project cash flow report for MHA-review only.

d) Confirmation of Submission of FY2027 MHA Budget to EOHLC.

e) The Executive Director noted the significant contribution of the Board particularly in the last several months and thanked the Board for their service.

## ADJOURNMENT

After due discussion and upon motion duly made by Karin H. Nystrom and seconded by Emmanuel Marsh, it was unanimously:

**VOTED:** To Adjourn

**Ayes:** William P. Hurley, Joan M. Chiasson, Frank M. Molis, Emmanuel Marsh and Karin H. Nystrom

**Nays:** None

Adjourned at 9:20 AM
